prompt: Who was the winner of Tour de France the same year that a major catastrophic crash happened at Circuit de la Sarthe in Le Mans, France?
answer: The winner was **Louison Bobet of France**, who won the **1955 Tour de France**. The catastrophic crash at the Circuit de la Sarthe occurred during the 1955 24 Hours of Le Mans.
